import os, zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)
Q = {'m': NS}

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data.xlsx.new'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    names = zin.namelist()
    blobs = {n: zin.read(n) for n in names}

# ---------- sheet1.xml ----------
sroot = ET.fromstring(blobs['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])

dim = sroot.find('m:dimension', Q)
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

cols = sroot.find('m:cols', Q)
newcol = ET.SubElement(cols, '{%s}col' % NS)
newcol.set('min', '8'); newcol.set('max', '8')
newcol.set('width', '14'); newcol.set('customWidth', '1')

sheetData = sroot.find('m:sheetData', Q)
for row in sheetData.findall('m:row', Q):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    c = ET.SubElement(row, '{%s}c' % NS)
    c.set('r', 'H%d' % r)
    if r == 1:
        c.set('s', '1'); c.set('t', 'inlineStr')
        is_ = ET.SubElement(c, '{%s}is' % NS)
        t = ET.SubElement(is_, '{%s}t' % NS)
        t.text = 'Profit Margin (%)'
    else:
        c.set('s', '3')
        f = ET.SubElement(c, '{%s}f' % NS)
        f.text = 'G%d/E%d' % (r, r)

# ---------- styles.xml ----------
stroot = ET.fromstring(blobs['xl/styles.xml'])

numFmts = stroot.find('m:numFmts', Q)
numFmts.set('count', '1')
nf = ET.SubElement(numFmts, '{%s}numFmt' % NS)
nf.set('numFmtId', '164')
nf.set('formatCode', '0.0%;-0.0%;-')

cellXfs = stroot.find('m:cellXfs', Q)
cellXfs.set('count', '4')
xf = ET.SubElement(cellXfs, '{%s}xf' % NS)
xf.set('numFmtId', '164'); xf.set('fontId', '0'); xf.set('fillId', '0')
xf.set('borderId', '0'); xf.set('pivotButton', '0'); xf.set('quotePrefix', '0'); xf.set('xfId', '0')

# ---------- write new package ----------
with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for n in names:
        if n == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            zout.writestr(n, ET.tostring(sroot, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True))
        elif n == 'xl/styles.xml':
            zout.writestr(n, ET.tostring(stroot, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True))
        else:
            zout.writestr(n, blobs[n])

os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('done', os.path.getsize(SRC))
